images.alt: De majesteit op de heilige berg — 2 Petrus 1:17; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 2 Peter 1:16–18 recalls eyewitnesses seeing Jesus’ majesty and hearing the heavenly voice on the holy mountain. Respectful first-century biblical transfiguration scene: Jesus standing on a quiet rocky mountaintop in radiant fully covering white robes, three adult male disciples nearby looking up in awe, all natural two arms each. The radiance comes from soft brilliant light around Jesus, no visible human portrait of the Father, sky face, written speech, wings, exaggerated magical anatomy or frightening lightning. Dignified photorealism, uncluttered landscape 3:2.

No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 2 Peter 2:5 says God preserved Noah and seven others during the flood. Ancient Genesis-era ark interior: exactly eight adult humans total, four men and four women in simple modest opaque robes, gathered calmly together inside a spacious wooden ark room, muted daylight through a high window with rain beyond. Noah elderly with grey beard, the seven others varied adults. Clear separate faces and limbs, no ninth human or child, no drowning bodies, modern ship machinery or readable text. Focus on the household preserved, not ark construction.
